title: The Letter of Ashcombe
author: Felix Vasquez
blurb: Gideon Blackwood, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
